item.title: State Senate Passes Cellphone Ban in High School Bill Unanimously - 92.1 WLHR
item.description: Cellphones will be banned in Georgia public high schools starting in the 2027-28 school year, if Gov. Brian Kemp signs House Bill 1009 into law. The state Senate passed the measure unanimously on Monday. Rep. Scott Hilton, R-Peachtree Corners, the author of the bill, called it a great, great, win for students and classrooms.
